## New cards {#sec-level-3-cards}

### Entanglement and lane measurement

*Description:* No effect if you are in a defined lane, or if no other player is in a colour superposition.

Otherwise, you are the control C. Pick a player in a colour superposition as the target T. You are now entangled. One lane measurement puts you both in a defined lane.
Roll the D6:
1-3, C: move to outer lane, T: no change
4-6, C: move to inner lane, T: change laneMoved counters keep the same number. C: change the colour of the counter you move.

Number of cards per deck: 5

### Entanglement and colour measurement

*Description:* No effect if you are in a defined lane, or if no other player is in a colour superposition.

Otherwise, you are the control C. Pick a player in a colour superposition as the target T. You are now entangled. A colour measurement puts you both in a defined colour.
Roll the D6:
1-3, T: change the white counter to black, C: no change
4-6, T: change black counter to white, C: change colourMoved counters keep the same number. T: move the counter you flip to the other lane.

Number of cards per deck: 5


See the Level 3 rows of the card reference (@sec-cards).
